LanguageData.SGA_GroupSizeTip: Average and gap are calculated for the N pawns with the highest level in each skill. Gap = highest - lowest level inside that group. N is capped by the number of pawns that have the skill.
LanguageData.SGA_RankingNote: All pawns by level. Highlighted pawns are used for the average and gap.
LanguageData.SGA_AvgTip: Average of the top N levels of the skill. Lower means the colony is weaker at it.
LanguageData.SGA_ResetTip: Reset the view to its defaults: no slaves, prisoners or children, N = 3, all skills, default sorting.
LanguageData.SGA_OpenMethod: How to open the analysis window
LanguageData.SGA_HotkeyHint: Assign the key in Options > Keyboard config (category: Skill Gap Analyzer). No key is assigned by default.
